last.verdict: Profit is still falling about 15% and North America volumes keep shrinking; the raised full-year profit guidance comes from tax and other income, not better operations.

takeaways.label: Profit still sliding
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income fell 15.2% to $939M on higher shipping and ingredient costs, bonus pay and advertising. Adjusted EPS of $0.53 compared with $0.61 a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Guidance raise is thin
takeaways.text: Profit outlook stays down 16-18%. The EPS range rose to $2.07-$2.13 from $2.03-$2.09, helped by a lower tax rate and more other income. The sales range's low end improved to down 1.25%.

takeaways.label: U.S. still weak
takeaways.text: North America sales fell 3.4%, with volume down 2.4% in meats, sauces and drinks. Segment profit fell 10.5%. Emerging markets organic sales rose 15.6%, but they are the smallest region.

takeaways.label: Headwinds in outlook
takeaways.text: Guidance builds in about $700M of extra brand spending, margins at the low end of the prior range, and roughly 100 basis points of sales drag from reduced SNAP food assistance. The planned split into two companies remains paused.

history.verdict: Investors sold the stock as profit kept shrinking while spending on brands rose.

reasons.label: Profit falling sharply
reasons.text: Adjusted operating income fell 18.4% to $1.0B as advertising and costs rose.

reasons.label: Spending raised again
reasons.text: Extra 2026 brand investment rose $100M to about $700M, weighing on near-term profit.

reasons.label: Sales still shrinking
reasons.text: Sales fell 1.3% as meats and Lunchables-type products lagged; outlook only trimmed to down 0.5-2%.
